caption.text: Emergency lights are active. Please follow the marked route.

caption.speaker: Station
caption.text: Rescue bus disconnected. Auxiliary power can now be restored.

caption.speaker: Station
caption.text: Auxiliary power restored. Medical and archive access available.

caption.speaker: Crew recording
caption.text: My visitor token still works. Do not call the rescue network.

caption.speaker: Crew recording
caption.text: Close the coolant return, not the pressure supply. Send this to the independent capsule.

caption.speaker: Station
caption.text: Coolant return isolated. Observation quarantine released.

caption.speaker: Station
caption.text: Recording received. One evacuation berth is available.

caption.speaker: Station
caption.text: Separation confirmed. You are clear of the station.

lossEnding.title: YOU WERE CAUGHT
lossEnding.message: The responder caught you. Restart from the docking airlock.

winEnding.title: CLEAR OF NULL MERIDIAN
winEnding.message: The crew archive is safe. The rescue network is behind you. You are free to leave.

captions.text: Station: Separation confirmed. You are clear of the station.
